items.w1_intro: Hello, my name is Cloud. I'm from Fix-well Technology in Hsinchu, Taiwan. We repair semiconductor test equipment — testers, probers, and power supplies. I handle repair cases and customer communication. If you have any equipment problems, please contact me anytime. Nice to meet you.
items.w1_s2: This is Cloud from Fix-well Technology.
items.w1_s3: We are a repair service company for semiconductor test equipment.
items.w1_s4: I will check the details and update you by Friday.
items.w1_s5: Please let me know if you have any questions.
